title: 统一 AST 草稿编辑

interface.DraftEditorProps: repository, actor, matterId, targetId; optional onGenerateDraft, onPreview, onExport, bufferStore, confirmationRevisionId and confirmedParagraphIds. Parent supplies only confirmations valid for the named revision. Without preview/export callbacks the component dispatches revision-bound v6:draft-preview and v6:draft-export events.
interface.session: DraftEditorSession owns load/refresh, IndexedDB buffer recovery, edits, INVALID_AST locations, VERSION_CONFLICT merge state and save. Default buffer rows reuse LocalRepository's blobs store and are scoped by tenant/user, targetId and baseRevisionId.
interface.revisionWrite: Uses createGenerationRevisionStore.loadHeadRevision/loadRevision/saveEditedRevision. Successful writes use reason=edited and the baseRevisionId CAS. Repeated save after success returns the current saved revision without another event.

acceptance.observed: Edited a paragraph through DraftEditorSession, saved a new reason=edited head, and verified the preview/export projections carry that revision id and edited AST. Repeated save left the revision.created event count unchanged. The browser harness repeated edit/save and verified both callbacks reference the new head.

A competing revision advanced the head. Saving from the old base returned VERSION_CONFLICT, retained the target+baseRevisionId buffer, showed the latest revision beside the local text, and did not change the head. Starting merge uses the latest revision as a new base and preserves the old local buffer for comparison.

Refresh restored the same head and invalid local buffer. Repeated save after success added no event. Schema-invalid claim dependency returned INVALID_AST with claim 2's node id and number; invalid figureIds returned INVALID_AST at the containing paragraph. Pure edit/insert/delete preserved their input models and assigned the injected id to the inserted paragraph. Editing a legacy paragraph changed its origin to human; deleting AI content created exactly one auditable edited revision event.

specAcceptance.reason: This is the R2 paid-content projection rule across preview, revisions, jobs and search. V6-18 adds the R1 local editor and revision-bound projections; it does not implement a cloud content-projection service or locked revision/job/search DTOs.

RiskDTO checks, locked-section risk redaction and the read-only preview annotation surface are outside the editor component and its authorized write set. No locked paragraph text is fetched by this local editor.

All five AI paragraphs are first treated as confirmed for the base revision. Editing the second paragraph and saving produces a new revision; the prior revision id no longer validates those confirmations, so all five are pending. Browser capture also observed five pending markers after save.
Stale base save returns VERSION_CONFLICT, retains the local buffer, displays both local/latest text, and leaves the new head unchanged.
Restore, restoredFrom, figureStrategy and confirmation/approval non-inheritance require the restore command and are outside V6-18's write set.

The adopted_inputs confirmation dialog and adopted_inputs revision command are outside this ticket. The editor detects stale source/config/figure input and refuses save with INPUT_STALE while preserving the buffer; it does not silently rebase stale content.
risk_ack recording and the S12 expert-service route are separate confirmation/service flows, outside the AST editor and its write set.
A claim 2 dependency on later claim 3 is rejected as INVALID_AST and mapped to claim 2's id/number for UI location.
The editor exposes a revision-bound preview projection callback but does not render the separate R1 PreviewDTO page. No payment/unlock UI or paid preview is introduced by this ticket.

limitations: Status remains candidate pending independent review; no changes were committed or pushed.
V6-17's revision seam does not expose revision history summaries or node-level diffs, so the editor renders the current head and conflict comparison only.
restore/adopted_inputs/risk_ack operations and the full S05 PreviewDTO, paid-content locking, and risk annotation screens are outside this ticket's write set.

The editor blocks known stale source/config/figure inputs and validates figureIds against readFigureLibrary's current figure set. The V6-17 save seam does not atomically bind its CAS to the DraftInputRef/figure-set snapshot, so a narrow concurrent input/figure update between this read and seam commit remains unverified.
Confirmation records are not written by this editor. Parent-supplied confirmedParagraphIds are honored only when confirmationRevisionId matches the current head; a newly saved revision inherits none.
The editor component is exported but not registered in V6App/navigation; shared registration is orchestrator-owned. Browser evidence used a direct component harness.
Node 25.8.1 was available; the architecture specifies Node 22, which was unavailable and remains unverified.
The successful web build reports Vite's existing chunk-size warning for several minified chunks over 500 kB.

decisionsRequested.question: Should the revision seam accept and atomically compare the caller's base DraftInputRef/figureRevisionId, or should a follow-up add a distinct adopted_inputs flow before stale edits can be saved?
decisionsRequested.suggestion: Keep the editor's current INPUT_STALE refusal and extend the seam in an orchestrator-owned follow-up with an input snapshot precondition. Preserve adopted_inputs as a separate explicit, confirmed operation.
decisionsRequested.impact: The current UI detects stale inputs and prevents known stale saves, but saveEditedRevision itself only CAS-checks baseRevisionId and reads the current DraftInputRef. This leaves a narrow concurrent input/figure race and no adopted_inputs recovery path in V6-18.
